coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (registered Phase 0/2; translational subset). Each arm has one investigational PARP inhibitor (pamiparib in A and B, olaparib in C), so each is experimental_monotherapy on a radiotherapy plus temozolomide backbone. The Arm C text mentions pamiparib in the maintenance phase, probably a registry typo; not coded. MGMT unmethylated status is stated as the criterion for the phase 2 newly diagnosed pamiparib cohort (enrichment, not candidate-matched). PAR is a pharmacodynamic outcome.
